## Goal
`tests/test_state.py` checks selected transitions and one ladder walk. Nothing checks every state of `src/freemyid/state.py` (in-house only).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. For every `ListingState` x found (True/False) x prior submission (None / a datetime), `after_scan` (74-91) returns a state that `can_transition` (35-41) allows from the current state, and `transition` (43-61) accepts it. Any combination that fails is a strict xfail per case citing the line (for example UNKNOWN with `last_submitted_at` set and found -> REAPPEARED, which `TRANSITIONS[UNKNOWN]` at 19 does not list).
2. `transition` changes `attempts`/`last_submitted_at` only when entering SUBMITTED from another state (52-54), clears `needs_human_reason` when leaving NEEDS_HUMAN (55-56) and resets the escalation fields on REMOVED/NOT_FOUND (57-59).
3. `next_escalation` (123-138): the level never decreases, never exceeds the ladder length, `due_at` is at least the anchor plus `escalation_window` (119-120), and the action is NONE outside SUBMITTED/AWAITING_VERIFICATION/CONFIRMED.
4. `next_check_at` (141-151) over every state x weekly (True/False) x processing/recheck days across their model bounds: always strictly after `now`; with weekly=True, FOUND, REAPPEARED and NEEDS_HUMAN are at most 7 days out.
5. `should_submit` (94-95) is true for exactly FOUND and REAPPEARED.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Offline: no network, no sockets (FastAPI `TestClient` is fine), no git, no installs, no new dependencies. Tests must pass on Windows CI too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp`, no `/`-joined path strings or other POSIX-only assumptions (WO-217 broke windows-latest that way). The module under test is outside Codex's code lane: a real product bug = `pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason=...)` plus a finding with file:line in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit it. Check `tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first and don't duplicate a guard. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them in your worktree.
